method_note: Each point is the single OneMap address-search feature for the street address Global Switch gives for the facility (Singapore page, Internet Archive raw copy of 10 June 2026, and the live About page version modified 19 October 2026). The served WGS84 latitude/longitude was re-derived from the served SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y with pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 (always_xy, EPSG:3414 -> EPSG:4326); the geodesic difference is about 1.6e-9 m for both points. A search for each postcode returned a byte-identical single result. No geocoding beyond the official address search, no offsets and no rounding were applied. No commercial map, map embed, short link, PeeringDB record or OpenStreetMap service was used.
site_versus_campus_review: Global Switch Tai Seng and Global Switch Woodlands are separate physical sites: the operator lists them as two facilities with separate street addresses and postcodes (2 Tai Seng Avenue, Singapore 534408; 7 Woodlands Height, Singapore 737858) and separate capacity labels (17 MW and 22 MW), and the two address points are 14.75 km apart (WGS84 geodesic).

candidates.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: OneMap supplies no positional accuracy for address points; decimal places are not survey accuracy.
